          <text>Original source</text>
        </name>
        <initialMarking>
          <text>1</text>
        </initialMarking>
      </place>
      <place id="sink">
        <name>
          <text>Original sink</text>
        </name>
      </place>
      <transition id="original-transition-0">
        <name>
          <text>A</text>
        </name>
      </transition>
      <transition id="original-transition-1">
        <name>
          <text>B</text>
        </name>
      </transition>
      <arc id="a-in" source="source" target="original-transition-0">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="a-out" source="original-transition-0" target="sink">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="b-in" source="source" target="original-transition-1">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="b-out" source="original-transition-1" target="sink">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
    </page>
    <finalmarkings>
      <marking>
        <place idref="sink">
          <text>1</text>
        </place>
      </marking>
    </finalmarkings>
  </net>
</pnml>
